title: Trying to decide whether to cancel...
text: When I first subscribed it was $15.00 a box, and it arrived well-packaged with tissue paper, and the products nicely packed inside in a sturdy box (that was so nice that in some cases I found uses for the boxes themselves inside drawers, etc.,) -- it was definitely a good value, if a bit heavy on the serum/moisturizer side.  Now the price has gone up to $23.00 (nearly $26 with tax), the boxes arrive with the items rattling around loose inside a much thinner box.  Not enough cosmetic products ... and far too many masks and serums and moisturizers.  I will give it one more month, but after that will probably cancel.  Price has gone up and the quality and variety of the content has decreased.
label: neutral
